reviewNote: Where it is in the app: Profile tab, the Joker Pro card, then choose a plan and tap the yellow button. No account is needed: a guest can buy, and Restore purchases is on the same sheet and in Profile, Settings, Subscription. The game itself stays free; Joker Pro adds analysis of the Joker Move in every game, a puzzle pack, the whole career at once, more XP and streak freezes, a gold name.
